# decision 0239 (ship6, PROVISIONAL): hybrid set U, module fle = the functions that fe-wasmgen lowers to direct wasm: of the functions executed in the 18 operation scripts of decision 0231 (hyb-L5-<module>.txt, hyb-L6-<ogg|elq>.txt, and the 2 Elastique functions over WASMGEN_MAX_FN_COST=30000000), those that make 99.99% of the executed instructions of all modules together (3,942 functions), without the 63 functions whose direct wasm body is >= 20,000 B and that run in the start-up scripts (start / par-boot) and are not in hyb-sse2-F2x (they cost first idle: V8 compiles them with Liftoff when they are first called).
